name: sign_preserves
stmt: theorem sign_preserves (x a : ℝ) : x = a ↔ Real.sign (x - a) = 0
proof:
by
  rw [Real.sign_eq_zero_iff]
  constructor <;> intro h <;> linarith

name: sumRelu_eq_zero_iff_each
stmt:
lemma sumRelu_eq_zero_iff_each (xs : List (ℝ × ℝ)) :
    SumRelu xs = 0 ↔ ∀ p ∈ xs, ReluOut p.1 p.2 = 0
proof:
by
  unfold SumRelu
  induction xs with
  | nil => simp
  | cons h t ih =>
      constructor
      · intro hsum p hp
        simp at hp
        rcases hp with rfl | ht
        ·                                         
          have hsum' : relu (p.1 - p.2) +
              (t.map (fun q => relu (q.1 - q.2))).foldr (fun a b => a + b) 0 = 0 := by
            simpa using hsum
          have hrestNonneg : 0 ≤
              (t.map (fun q => relu (q.1 - q.2))).foldr (fun a b => a + b) 0 := by
            simpa [SumRelu] using sumRelu_nonneg t
          have hh : relu (p.1 - p.2) = 0 := by
            nlinarith [relu_nonneg (p.1 - p.2), hrestNonneg]
          exact hh
        ·                     
          have hsum' : relu (h.1 - h.2) +
              (t.map (fun q => relu (q.1 - q.2))).foldr (fun a b => a + b) 0 = 0 := by
            simpa using hsum
          have hrestNonneg : 0 ≤
              (t.map (fun q => relu (q.1 - q.2))).foldr (fun a b => a + b) 0 := by
            simpa [SumRelu] using sumRelu_nonneg t
          have hrest : (t.map (fun q => relu (q.1 - q.2))).foldr (fun a b => a + b) 0 = 0 := by
            nlinarith [relu_nonneg (h.1 - h.2), hrestNonneg]
          exact (ih.mp hrest) p ht
      · intro hall
        have hh : relu (h.1 - h.2) = 0 := hall h (by simp)
        have ht : ∀ p ∈ t, ReluOut p.1 p.2 = 0 := fun p hp => hall p (by simp [hp])
        have hrest : (t.map (fun p => relu (p.1 - p.2))).foldr (fun a b => a + b) 0 = 0 := ih.mpr ht
        simp [hh,

name: sumRelu_all_constraints
stmt:
theorem sumRelu_all_constraints (xs : List (ℝ × ℝ)) :
    (∀ p ∈ xs, LeConstrR p.1 p.2) ↔ SumRelu xs = 0
proof:
by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hout : ∀ p ∈ xs, ReluOut p.1 p.2 = 0 := fun p hp => (relu_preserves p.1 p.2).mp (h p hp)
    exact (sumRelu_eq_zero_iff_each xs).mpr hout
  · intro h p hp
    exact (relu_preserves p.1 p.2).mpr ((sumRelu_eq_zero_iff_each xs).mp h p hp)

name: sumRelu_pos_of_unsatisfied
stmt:
theorem sumRelu_pos_of_unsatisfied (xs : List (ℝ × ℝ)) (p : ℝ × ℝ) (hp : p ∈ xs)
    (h : ¬ LeConstrR p.1 p.2) : 0 < SumRelu xs
proof:
by
  have hout : ReluOut p.1 p.2 ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    exact h ((relu_preserves p.1 p.2).mpr hz)
                      
  have hpos : 0 < relu (p.1 - p.2) := lt_of_le_of_ne (relu_nonneg (p.1 - p.2)) (by intro hz; exact hout (by simpa [ReluOut, hz]))
            
  have hle : relu (p.1 - p.2) ≤ SumRelu xs := by
    unfold SumRelu
                             
    induction xs with
    | nil => simp at hp
    | cons h2 t ih =>
        simp at hp
        rcases hp with rfl | ht
        ·                                             
          have hrest : 0 ≤ (t.map (fun q => relu (q.1 - q.2))).foldr (fun a b => a + b) 0 := by
            exact sumRelu_nonneg t
          change relu (p.1 - p.2) ≤
            relu (p.1 - p.2) + (t.map (fun q => relu (q.1 - q.2))).foldr (fun a b => a + b) 0
          nlinarith
        ·                     
          have : relu (p.1 - p.2) ≤ (t.map (fun q => relu (q.1 - q.2))).foldr (fun a b => a + b) 0 := ih ht
          have h2nonneg : 0 ≤ relu (h2.1 - h2.2) := relu_nonneg _
          change relu (p.1 - p.2) ≤
            relu (h2.1 - h2.2) + (t.map (fun q => relu (q.1 - q.2))).foldr (fun a b => a + b) 0
          nlinarith
  exact lt_of_lt_of_le hpos hle

end Lattice

name: verify_probability_guarantee
stmt:
theorem verify_probability_guarantee {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] {μ : Measure α} {f : α → ℝ}
    (hf_nonneg : 0 ≤ᵐ[μ] f) (hf_int : Integrable f μ) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hE : ∫ x, f x ∂μ ≤ ε ^ 2) :
    (μ { x | ε ≤ f x }).toReal ≤ ε
proof:
by
                                    
  calc
    (μ { x | ε ≤ f x }).toReal ≤ (1 / ε) * ∫ x, f x ∂μ := markov_bound hf_nonneg hf_int hε
    _ ≤ (1 / ε) * ε ^ 2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hE (le_of_lt (one_div_pos.mpr hε))
    _ = ε := by
      field_simp [ne_of_gt hε]
      ring

                    
                                   
                                 
                                                     
                                       
                        

end Lattice

name: splitLast_append_singleton
doc:
**`splitLast` 规范形**：`splitLast (a ++ [b]) = (a, b)`。

这是往返恒等的关键引理：由它立即得到「编码段能原样恢复 `(a, b)`」。
stmt:
theorem splitLast_append_singleton (a : List Int) (b : Int) :
    splitLast (a ++ [b]) = (a, b)
proof:
by
  induction a with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons h t ih =>
      cases t with
      | nil => rfl
      | cons h2 t2 =>
                                                     
          show (h :: (splitLast ((h2 :: t2) ++ [b])).1,
                (splitLast ((h2 :: t2) ++ [b])).2) = (h :: h2 :: t2, b)
          rw [ih]

name: foldGo_idem
doc: **状态机幂等**：对自身输出再跑一次是恒等。
stmt: theorem foldGo_idem (b : Bool) (l : List Char) : foldGo b (foldGo b l) = foldGo b l
proof:
by
  induction l generalizing b with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons c rest ih =>
    cases b with
    | false =>
      cases hc : isBlank c with
      | true =>
        simp only [foldGo, hc, if_true, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false]
        have hblank : isBlank ' ' = true := by decide
        simp only [foldGo, hblank, if_true]
        rw [ih true]
      | false =>
        simp only [foldGo, hc, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false]
        rw [ih false]
    | true =>
      cases hc : isBlank c with
      | true =>
        simp only [foldGo, hc, if_true]
        rw [ih true]
      | false =>
        simp only [foldGo, hc, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false]
        rw [ih false]

name: foldBlanks_idem
doc: ⭐ **`foldBlanks` 是幂等投影**（归一化的定义性质）。
stmt: theorem foldBlanks_idem (l : List Char) : foldBlanks (foldBlanks l) = foldBlanks l
proof: foldGo_idem false l

name: lookupTok_eq_some
doc: ⭐ **`lookupTok` 是 `pieceOf` 的真逆**——这是词表良性的精确刻画。
stmt:
theorem lookupTok_eq_some {a : List Char} {t : CharToken} :
    lookupTok a = some t ↔ pieceOf t = a
proof:
by
  constructor
  · intro h
    cases a with
    | nil => simp [lookupTok] at h
    | cons c rest =>
        cases rest with
        | nil =>
            simp only [lookupTok, Option.some.injEq] at h
            rw [← h]; rfl
        | cons c2 rest2 =>
            simp only [lookupTok, Option.some.injEq] at h
            rw [← h]; rfl
  · intro h
    subst h
    cases t with
    | single c => rfl
    | word c1 c2 rest => rfl

name: tokAux_detok
doc:
⭐ **`tokAux` 的不变式**：返回 `some ts` ⟹ `detokenize ts = detokenize done ++ rest`。

即「输出重新拼出输入」——**拼写无损**，这是本层能有的最强陈述。
stmt:
theorem tokAux_detok (fuel : Nat) (done : List CharToken) (rest : List Char)
    {ts : List CharToken} (h : tokAux fuel done rest = some ts) :
    detokenize ts = detokenize done ++ rest
proof:
by
  induction fuel generalizing done rest with
  | zero => simp [tokAux] at h
  | succ n ih =>
      cases rest with
      | nil =>
          simp only [tokAux, Option.some.injEq] at h
          subst h
          simp
      | cons c tl =>
          simp only [tokAux] at h
          split at h
          · exact absurd h (by simp)
          · rename_i t ht
            obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := bestPrefix_spec ht
            have hdrop : (c :: tl).drop (pieceOf t).length = u := by
              rw [← hu]; exact List.drop_left (pieceOf t) u
            have hih := ih (done ++ [t]) ((c :: tl).drop (pieceOf t).length) h
            rw [hdrop] at hih
            rw [hih, detokenize_append, detokenize_singleton]
            rw [← hu]
            simp [List.append_assoc]

name: lookupTok_ne_none
doc: 非空列表必可查到（最长前缀即为它自己或它的短前缀）。
stmt: theorem lookupTok_ne_none (l : List Char) (hl : l ≠ []) : lookupTok l ≠ none
proof:
by
  cases l with
  | nil => exact absurd rfl hl
  | cons c rest =>
    cases rest with
    | nil => simp [lookupTok]
    | cons c2 r2 => simp [lookupTok]

name: bestPrefix_ne_none
doc: 非空输入上 `bestPrefix` 必命中（因为输入自身就是自己的最长前缀）。
stmt:
theorem bestPrefix_ne_none (rest : List Char) (hrest : rest ≠ []) :
    bestPrefix rest ≠ none
proof:
by
  intro h
  unfold bestPrefix at h
  rw [List.findSome?_eq_none_iff] at h
  have hmem : rest ∈ rest.inits.reverse := by
    apply List.mem_reverse.mpr
    exact (List.mem_inits rest rest).mpr (⟨[], by simp⟩ : rest <+: rest)
  have := h rest hmem
  have hne : rest.isEmpty = false := by
    cases rest with
    | nil => exact absurd rfl hrest
    | cons c r => rfl
  rw [hne] at this
  simp at this
  exact lookupTok_ne_none rest hrest this

name: tokAux_ne_none
doc:
⭐ **`tokAux` 从不返回 `none`**（燃料充足时）。关键：每步至少消耗 1 字符，
故 `rest.length` 严格递减，燃料 `length + 1` 恒够。
stmt:
theorem tokAux_ne_none (fuel : Nat) (done : List CharToken) (rest : List Char)
    (hf : rest.length < fuel) : tokAux fuel done rest ≠ none
proof:
by
  induction fuel generalizing done rest with
  | zero => simp at hf
  | succ n ih =>
      cases rest with
      | nil => simp [tokAux]
      | cons c tl =>
          have hne : bestPrefix (c :: tl) ≠ none := bestPrefix_ne_none _ (by simp)
          unfold tokAux
          cases hbf : bestPrefix (c :: tl) with
          | none => exact absurd hbf hne
          | some t =>
            intro h
            have hlen : 0 < (pieceOf t).length :=
              List.length_pos_of_ne_nil (pieceOf_ne_nil t)
            have hdrop : ((c :: tl).drop (pieceOf t).length).length < n := by
              rw [List.length_drop, List.length_cons]
              simp only [List.length_cons] at hf
              omega
            exact ih (done ++ [t]) _ hdrop h

name: foldBlanks_length_le
stmt: theorem foldBlanks_length_le (l : List Char) : (foldBlanks l).length ≤ l.length
proof: foldGo_length_le false l

name: detokenize_tokenize_on_quotient
doc:
⭐⭐ **商可逆（核心定理）**：`detokenize ∘ tokenize` 把 `s` 送回**它自己的 σ-类**。

即：`SameTokens (detokenize (tokenize s)) s`。
这是 L0⇄L1 上唯一可能的可逆性形式（严格左逆因非单射而不存在）。
stmt:
theorem detokenize_tokenize_on_quotient (s : List Char) :
    SameTokens (detokenize ((tokenize s).getD [])) s
proof:
by
  obtain ⟨ts0, hts0⟩ := tokenize_never_none s
  cases h : tokenize s with
  | none => exact absurd h (by rw [hts0]; simp)
  | some ts =>
      show tokenize (detokenize (Option.getD (some ts) [])) = tokenize s
      rw [h]
      simp only [Option.getD_some]
      exact detokenize_left_inverse_on_quotient h

name: tokenize_detokenize_galois
doc:
⭐ **Galois 连接（精确刻画）**：`tokenize s = some ts` ⟺
`s` 与 `detokenize ts` 同类**且** `ts` 本身是规范的（重分词回到自身）。

⚠ **诚实标注**：合取项 `tokenize (detokenize ts) = some ts` **不可省**——无条件版为假
（反例 `ts := [single 'a', single 'a']`：`detokenize ts = "aa"`，同类成立但
`tokenize "aa" = some [word 'a' 'a' []] ≠ some ts`）。见文件头「诚实边界」。
stmt:
theorem tokenize_detokenize_galois (s : List Char) (ts : List CharToken) :
    tokenize s = some ts ↔
      (SameTokens s (detokenize ts) ∧ tokenize (detokenize ts) = some ts)
proof:
by
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact ⟨by
      show tokenize s = tokenize (detokenize ts)
      rw [h]
      exact (detokenize_left_inverse_on_quotient h).symm,
      detokenize_left_inverse_on_quotient h⟩
  · intro ⟨h1, h2⟩
    show tokenize s = some ts
    rw [show tokenize s = tokenize (detokenize ts) from h1]
    exact h2

end Lattice

name: tokenizeStr_eq_tokenize
doc:
⭐ **组合律（入口桥穿过 L0 不改变语义）**：`tokenizeStr` 就是 `tokenize ∘ encode`。

这是本桥与 L0 的**接口契约**：任何关于 `tokenize` 的既有定理
（`tokenize_detok` / `detokenize_left_inverse_on_quotient` / `tokenize_detokenize_galois` …）
都可以经 `rw [tokenizeStr_eq_tokenize]` **原样**用在 `String` 输入上。
stmt:
theorem tokenizeStr_eq_tokenize (s : String) :
    tokenizeStr s = tokenize (Text.encode s)
proof: rfl

name: tokenizeStr_never_none
doc:
⭐ **入口分词永不失败**（由 `tokenize_never_none` 经组合律继承）。

⚠ **诚实标注**：它继承的正是 `RealTokenization` 的**退化词表**性质
（文件头 :65-70 已登记：真实词表有 OOV）。⇒ 本定理**不**读作
「任意 `String` 都能被真实分词器切开」。**OOV 面的最小可证模型见 §三。**
stmt:
theorem tokenizeStr_never_none (s : String) :
    ∃ ts : List CharToken, tokenizeStr s = some ts
proof:
by
  obtain ⟨ts, hts⟩ := tokenize_never_none (Text.encode s)
  exact ⟨ts, by rw [tokenizeStr_eq_tokenize]; exact hts⟩

name: bestPrefixV_Vzz_oov
doc:
⭐⭐ **OOV 阻塞（`none` 分支【可达】）**：`['q']` 在 `Vzz` 下**不可切**。

这是本节存在的**唯一理由** —— 没有它，`none` 分支仍是死代码。
stmt: theorem bestPrefixV_Vzz_oov : bestPrefixV Vzz ['q'] = none
proof: by decide

name: realTotalLoss_verify
stmt:
theorem realTotalLoss_verify {n : Nat} (cs : Fin n → RealConstraint) (x : ℝ)
    (h : RealTotalLoss (compileFin cs) x = 0) : ∀ i : Fin n, RealConstraintSat (cs i) x
proof: (realTotalLoss_soundness cs x).mp h

name: realTotalLoss_pos_of_unsatisfied
stmt:
theorem realTotalLoss_pos_of_unsatisfied {n : Nat} (ls : Fin n → RealNeuron) (x : ℝ)
    (i : Fin n) (h : RealNeuronOut (ls i) x ≠ 0) : 0 < RealTotalLoss ls x
proof:
by
  unfold RealTotalLoss
                       
  have hsq : 0 < (RealNeuronOut (ls i) x) ^ 2 := by
    have hsq0 : (RealNeuronOut (ls i) x) ^ 2 ≠ 0 := by
      intro hs
      exact h (sq_eq_zero_iff.mp hs)
    exact lt_of_le_of_ne (sq_nonneg (RealNeuronOut (ls i) x)) (Ne.symm hsq0)
  have hsum_ge : (RealNeuronOut (ls i) x) ^ 2 ≤ ∑ j : Fin n, (RealNeuronOut (ls j) x) ^ 2 := by
                                   
    exact Finset.single_le_sum
      (fun j hj => sq_nonneg (RealNeuronOut (ls j) x)) (Finset.mem_univ i)
  exact lt_of_lt_of_le hsq hsum_ge

end Lattice

name: layerOfListRect_W
doc: **读回系数**：位置就是定义里写的那个。
stmt:
theorem layerOfListRect_W (s : List ℝ) (i : Fin m) (j : Fin n) :
    (layerOfListRect (m := m) (n := n) s).W i j = s.getD (i.val * n + j.val) 0
proof: rfl

name: layerOfListRect_b
doc: **读回偏置**：在 `m*n` 之后。
stmt:
theorem layerOfListRect_b (s : List ℝ) (j : Fin n) :
    (layerOfListRect (m := m) (n := n) s).b j = s.getD (m * n + j.val) 0
proof: rfl

name: listOfLayerRect_length
doc: **逆的长度是 `m*n + n`。**
stmt:
theorem listOfLayerRect_length (hn : 0 < n) (L : LayerParams (Fin m) (Fin n)) :
    (listOfLayerRect hn L).length = m * n + n
proof:
by
  unfold listOfLayerRect
  rw [List.length_append, List.length_ofFn, List.length_ofFn]

name: roundtrip_rect
doc:
**往返**：`listOfLayerRect` 是 `layerOfListRect` 的逆（长度匹配时）。

证明结构与方阵版相同：`List.ext_getElem` + `List.getElem_append_left`/`_right`
（它们的下标证明是**隐式**的，所以 `ext` 提供的证明自然匹配），
系数半归约成 `(k/n)*n + k%n = k`，偏置半归约成 `m*n + (k - m*n) = k`。
stmt:
theorem roundtrip_rect (hn : 0 < n) (s : List ℝ) (hlen : s.length = m * n + n) :
    listOfLayerRect hn (layerOfListRect (m := m) (n := n) s) = s
proof:
by
  apply List.ext_getElem
  · rw [listOfLayerRect_length, hlen]
  · intro k h1 h2
    unfold listOfLayerRect
    rcases Nat.lt_or_ge k (m * n) with hk | hk
    · rw [List.getElem_append_left (i := k) (as := List.ofFn (fun k : Fin (m * n) =>
          (layerOfListRect (m := m) (n := n) s).W
            ⟨k.val / n, (Nat.div_lt_iff_lt_mul hn).mpr k.isLt⟩ ⟨k.val % n, Nat.mod_lt _ hn⟩))
        (by rw [List.length_ofFn]; exact hk)]
      rw [List.getElem_ofFn, layerOfListRect_W]
      rw [Nat.mul_comm (k / n) n, Nat.div_add_mod k n]
      exact List.getD_eq_getElem _ _ h2
    · rw [List.getElem_append_right (i := k) (as := List.ofFn (fun k : Fin (m * n) =>
          (layerOfListRect (m := m) (n := n) s).W
            ⟨k.val / n, (Nat.div_lt_iff_lt_mul hn).mpr k.isLt⟩ ⟨k.val % n, Nat.mod_lt _ hn⟩))
        (by rw [List.length_ofFn]; exact hk)]
      rw [List.getElem_ofFn, layerOfListRect_b]
      simp only [Fin.val_mk]
      rw [List.length_ofFn, Nat.add_sub_cancel' hk]
      exact List.getD_eq_getElem _ _ h2

name: layerOfListRect_eq_full_width
doc:
**`m = n` 时退化为方阵版**：这是「推广而非平行」的机器检查形式。

方阵版 `layerOfListFull` 的 `W` 与 `b` 与本节的 `layerOfListRect` 在 `m = n` 时逐字相同。
stmt:
theorem layerOfListRect_eq_full_width {n : ℕ} (s : List ℝ) (i j : Fin n) :
    (layerOfListRect (m := n) (n := n) s).W i j =
        (FullWidth.layerOfListFull (n := n) s).W i j ∧
      (layerOfListRect (m := n) (n := n) s).b j =
        (FullWidth.layerOfListFull (n := n) s).b j
proof:
⟨rfl, rfl⟩

end Lattice.Lift.Rectangular

name: compileProgram_sound
doc:
**T1, list level.** If every item is accepted at `x`, every compiled item is
accepted at `encode x`.

An induction on the list uses nothing but the per-item obligation. No property of
`compile`, `encode` or the predicates is assumed, which is precisely why the result
survives a change of instance.
stmt:
theorem compileProgram_sound (ps : List P) (x : inputP) :
    C.EntailsP ps x → C.EntailsW (C.compileProgram ps) (C.encode x)
proof:
by
  intro h w hw
  rw [Compiler.compileProgram, List.mem_map] at hw
  obtain ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩ := hw
  exact C.sound p x (h p hp)

name: compileProgram_models
doc:
**T1, model level.** A compiled item accepts every point that the program accepts.

This is the form the rest of the ladder consumes: it composes with `Models` and is
strictly stronger than stating the property at one point.
stmt:
theorem compileProgram_models (ps : List P) (c : P) (hmem : c ∈ ps) :
    ∀ x : inputP, C.EntailsP ps x → C.satW (C.compile c) (C.encode x)
proof:
fun x hx => C.compileProgram_sound ps x hx (C.compile c)
    (List.mem_map_of_mem (f := C.compile) hmem)

name: sqSum_nonneg
stmt: lemma sqSum_nonneg (xs : List Int) : 0 ≤ sqSum xs
proof:
by
  unfold sqSum
  induction xs with
  | nil => simp
  | cons h t ih =>
      simp [List.foldr, pow_two]
      have hh : 0 ≤ h * h := by
        rcases le_total h 0 with hh1 | hh2
        · have hna : 0 ≤ -h := by omega
          have : 0 ≤ (-h) * (-h) := Int.mul_nonneg hna hna
          rw [neg_mul_neg] at this
          exact this
        · exact Int.mul_nonneg hh2 hh2
      unfold sqSum at ih
      simp [pow_two] at ih
      omega

(totalLoss_eq_zero_iff_allSatisfied cs x).mp h

end Lattice

name: residual_le_of_zero_on_dense
doc:
**验证的健全性（一般载体）。**

若 `r` 在 `Ω` 上 `L`-Lipschitz 且在 `δ`-稠密集 `S` 上为零，则 `Ω` 全域 `|r x| ≤ L·δ`。

`hL : 0 ≤ L` 不可省：`L < 0` 时 `L·δ` 可能为负，而 `|r x|` 非负，命题为假。

`hd` 要求 `s ∈ Ω`（不是只要求 `s ∈ S`）：`LipschitzOn` 只在 `Ω` 上有效，
若 `s ∉ Ω`，Lipschitz 条件对 `(x, s)` 一无所知。这一点写进定义而非留给读者推断，
是因为它就是命题成立与否的分界。
stmt:
theorem residual_le_of_zero_on_dense {r : X → ℝ} {L δ : ℝ} {Ω S : Set X}
    (hlip : ∀ x ∈ Ω, ∀ y ∈ Ω, |r x - r y| ≤ L * dist x y)
    (hL : 0 ≤ L)
    (hd : ∀ x ∈ Ω, ∃ s ∈ Ω, s ∈ S ∧ dist x s ≤ δ)
    (h0 : ∀ s ∈ S, r s = 0) :
    ∀ x ∈ Ω, |r x| ≤ L * δ
proof:
by
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨s, hsΩ, hsS, hxs⟩ := hd x hx
  have hEq : |r x| = |r x - r s| := by rw [h0 s hsS, sub_zero]
  rw [hEq]
  exact (hlip x hx s hsΩ).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hxs hL)

name: layerOfListFull_W
doc:
**The coefficient is read at the right index** -- by definition, recorded so the index arithmetic
is visible rather than buried.
stmt:
theorem layerOfListFull_W (s : List ℝ) (i j : Fin n) :
    (layerOfListFull (n := n) s).W i j = s.getD (i.val * n + j.val) 0
proof: rfl

name: layerOfListFull_b
doc: **The bias is read after the `n*n` coefficients.**
stmt:
theorem layerOfListFull_b (s : List ℝ) (j : Fin n) :
    (layerOfListFull (n := n) s).b j = s.getD (n * n + j.val) 0
proof: rfl

name: listOfLayer_length
doc: **Length of the inverse is `n*n + n`.**
stmt:
theorem listOfLayer_length (hn : 0 < n) (L : AffineLayer (Fin n)) :
    (listOfLayer hn L).length = n * n + n
proof:
by
  unfold listOfLayer
  rw [List.length_append, List.length_ofFn, List.length_ofFn]

name: roundtrip
doc:
**The round-trip**: the inverse recovers a list of the right length exactly.

Both halves go through `List.getElem_append_left/right` rather than through `listOfLayer_W`/`_b`,
because those state a FIXED index proof while `List.ext_getElem` supplies a different one. The append
lemmas take their proof argument implicitly, which is what lets the rewrite go through -- going through
the fixed-proof versions is where round 166 got stuck.

The coefficient half reduces to `(k/n)*n + k%n = k` (`Nat.div_add_mod` after `Nat.mul_comm`); the bias
half to `n*n + (k - n*n) = k` (`Nat.add_sub_cancel'`).
stmt:
theorem roundtrip (hn : 0 < n) (s : List ℝ) (hlen : s.length = n * n + n) :
    listOfLayer hn (layerOfListFull (n := n) s) = s
proof:
by
  apply List.ext_getElem
  · rw [listOfLayer_length, hlen]
  · intro k h1 h2
    unfold listOfLayer
    rcases Nat.lt_or_ge k (n * n) with hk | hk
    · rw [List.getElem_append_left (i := k) (as := List.ofFn (fun k : Fin (n * n) =>
          (layerOfListFull (n := n) s).W ⟨k.val / n, Nat.div_lt_of_lt_mul k.isLt⟩
            ⟨k.val % n, Nat.mod_lt _ hn⟩))
        (by rw [List.length_ofFn]; exact hk)]
      rw [List.getElem_ofFn, layerOfListFull_W]
      rw [Nat.mul_comm (k / n) n, Nat.div_add_mod k n]
      exact List.getD_eq_getElem _ _ h2
    · rw [List.getElem_append_right (i := k) (as := List.ofFn (fun k : Fin (n * n) =>
          (layerOfListFull (n := n) s).W ⟨k.val / n, Nat.div_lt_of_lt_mul k.isLt⟩
            ⟨k.val % n, Nat.mod_lt _ hn⟩))
        (by rw [List.length_ofFn]; exact hk)]
      rw [List.getElem_ofFn, layerOfListFull_b]
                                                                                            
      simp only [Fin.val_mk]
                                                                                               
                                                                                               
                                                                      
      rw [List.length_ofFn, Nat.add_sub_cancel' hk]
      exact List.getD_eq_getElem _ _ h2
end FullWidth

name: roundtrip_behavior
stmt:
theorem roundtrip_behavior (c : LinearConstraint) (x : Int) :
    (∀ l : LinearNeuron, NeuronOut l x = 0 → ConstraintSat (extract l) x) ∧
    (ConstraintSat c x → NeuronOut (convert c) x = 0)
proof:
by
  constructor
  · intro l h
    unfold extract ConstraintSat NeuronOut at *
    simpa using h
  · intro h
    exact (convert_preserves_semantics c x).mpr h

name: extract_is_valid
stmt:
theorem extract_is_valid (l : LinearNeuron) :
    ExtractionValid l (extract l)
proof:
by
  intro x
  unfold extract ConstraintSat NeuronOut
  rfl

end Lattice

name: compose_with_bridge
doc:
**两段组合需要桥**：若段 `f` 保持 `P`、段 `g` 保持 `Q`，
且 `P` 在转手点蕴含 `Q`，则末端满足 `Q`。

**桥 `hbridge` 不可省**——见 `bridge_is_necessary`。
stmt:
theorem compose_with_bridge {α : Type} (P Q : α → Prop) (f g : α → α)
    (hf : ∀ x, P x → P (f x)) (hg : ∀ x, Q x → Q (g x))
    (hbridge : ∀ x, P x → Q x)
    (x : α) (hx : P x) :
    Q (g (f x))
proof: hg (f x) (hbridge (f x) (hf x hx))

name: compose_three_with_bridges
doc:
**多段 + 逐段桥**：每段保持自己的性质，每对相邻性质之间有一座桥。

这是**非相邻组合的一般形式**：段数不限，但每两次转手都需要一座桥。
stmt:
theorem compose_three_with_bridges {α : Type} (P Q R : α → Prop)
    (f g h : α → α)
    (hf : ∀ x, P x → P (f x)) (hg : ∀ x, Q x → Q (g x)) (hh : ∀ x, R x → R (h x))
    (hPQ : ∀ x, P x → Q x) (hQR : ∀ x, Q x → R x)
    (x : α) (hx : P x) :
    R (h (g (f x)))
proof: hh (g (f x)) (hQR _ (hg (f x) (hPQ _ (hf x hx))))

name: bridge_is_necessary
doc:
**没有桥时，两段组合的结论不成立。**

反例：取 `α = ℕ`、`P x := x = 0`、`Q x := x = 1`、`f := id`、`g := id`。
则 `P`、`Q` 各自被 `id` 保持，但 `P 0` 成立而 `Q 0` 不成立。

⇒ **`ClauseComposition` 原边界声明「应当由传递性得到」过强。**
非相邻组合**需要一条桥**，不是免费得到。
stmt:
theorem bridge_is_necessary :
    ¬ (∀ (P Q : ℕ → Prop) (f g : ℕ → ℕ),
        (∀ x, P x → P (f x)) → (∀ x, Q x → Q (g x)) →
        ∀ x, P x → Q (g (f x)))
proof:
by
  intro h
  have hinst := h (fun x => x = 0) (fun x => x = 1) id id
    (fun _ hx => hx) (fun _ hx => hx) 0 rfl
  norm_num at hinst

end BridgedComposition

end Lattice.Audit

name: preserves_foldl
doc:
**传递性：逐阶段保持 ⟹ 整体保持。**

给定阶段列表 `steps : List (α → α)`，若每个阶段都保持性质 `P`，
则把这些阶段依次施加到 `x` 上之后 `P` 仍成立。

这是「链路可组合」的**一般形式**：它不假设阶段之间有任何关系，
只要求每段各自保持同一性质。于是任意多段都能串起来，
不必为每一对相邻条款单独论证。
stmt:
theorem preserves_foldl {α : Type} (P : α → Prop)
    (steps : List (α → α)) (hstep : ∀ f ∈ steps, ∀ x, P x → P (f x))
    (x : α) (hx : P x) :
    P (steps.foldl (fun acc f => f acc) x)
proof:
by
  induction steps generalizing x with
  | nil => exact hx
  | cons f rest ih =>
    apply ih
    · intro g hg
      exact hstep g (List.mem_cons_of_mem f hg)
    · exact hstep f (List.mem_cons_self f rest) x hx

name: preserves_two
doc: **两段是特例**：`[f, g]` 的整体保持。
stmt:
theorem preserves_two {α : Type} (P : α → Prop) (f g : α → α)
    (hf : ∀ x, P x → P (f x)) (hg : ∀ x, P x → P (g x)) (x : α) (hx : P x) :
    P (g (f x))
proof: hg (f x) (hf x hx)

name: preserves_one
doc:
**单段是特例**。单段、双段、任意多段是**同一条定理的三个投影**，
不是三条独立定理。
stmt:
theorem preserves_one {α : Type} (P : α → Prop) (f : α → α)
    (hf : ∀ x, P x → P (f x)) (x : α) (hx : P x) : P (f x)
proof: hf x hx

name: preserves_three
doc: **三段**：显式给出，说明链式右结合与 `foldl` 一致。
stmt:
theorem preserves_three {α : Type} (P : α → Prop) (f g h : α → α)
    (hf : ∀ x, P x → P (f x)) (hg : ∀ x, P x → P (g x)) (hh : ∀ x, P x → P (h x))
    (x : α) (hx : P x) : P (h (g (f x)))
proof:
hh (g (f x)) (hg (f x) (hf x hx))

end ChainTransitivity

namespace IterateForm

name: preserves_iterate
doc:
**迭代形式的保持律**：这是修复回路**实际使用**的形状。

`Nat.iterate f n` 与 `List.foldl` 是同一个想法的两个组合子，
但**类型不同**。一般定理不能直接套到回路上——这一点值得记录，
因为它说明「一般化」不等于「可套用」。
stmt:
theorem preserves_iterate {α : Type} (P : α → Prop) (f : α → α)
    (hf : ∀ x, P x → P (f x)) (n : ℕ) (x : α) (hx : P x) :
    P (Nat.iterate f n x)
proof:
by
  induction n generalizing x with
  | zero => exact hx
  | succ m ih => exact ih (f x) (hf x hx)

name: iterate_from_fold
doc:
**折叠形式蕴含迭代形式**（对常值阶段列表）。

两种形状**等价**：`foldl` 版本不更强，也不更弱，只是写在另一个组合子上。
stmt:
theorem iterate_from_fold {α : Type} (P : α → Prop) (f : α → α)
    (hf : ∀ x, P x → P (f x)) (n : ℕ) (x : α) (hx : P x) :
    P ((List.replicate n f).foldl (fun acc g => g acc) x)
proof:
ChainTransitivity.preserves_foldl P (List.replicate n f)
    (fun g _ y hy => by
      have hgf : g = f := List.eq_of_mem_replicate ‹g ∈ List.replicate n f›
      rw [hgf]; exact hf y hy)
    x hx

name: loop_preserves
doc:
**吸收律给出回路的保持律**：`Repair.preserves` 就是本定理在
`P := R.Sat`、`f := R.fix` 处的实例。

这条把一般定理**接到库自身的法则**上，证明实例化是真实的而非形式上的。
stmt:
theorem loop_preserves {α : Type} (R : Lattice.Core.Repair α) (n : ℕ) (x : α)
    (hx : R.Sat x) : R.Sat (Nat.iterate R.fix n x)
proof:
preserves_iterate R.Sat R.fix (fun y hy => by rw [R.absorbs y hy]; exact hy) n x hx

end IterateForm

end Lattice.Audit

name: nil_append
stmt: theorem nil_append (ks : Verdict) : emptyVerdict ++ ks = ks
proof: List.nil_append ks

name: append_nil
stmt: theorem append_nil (ks : Verdict) : ks ++ emptyVerdict = ks
proof: List.append_nil ks

name: append_assoc
stmt: theorem append_assoc (a b c : Verdict) : (a ++ b) ++ c = a ++ (b ++ c)
proof: List.append_assoc a b c

name: bridgedCount_sequential
doc: **同性质不需要桥**。
stmt:
theorem bridgedCount_sequential (ks : Verdict) :
    bridgedCount (.sequential :: ks) = bridgedCount ks
proof: rfl

name: bridgedCount_bridged
doc: **换性质需要一座桥**。
stmt:
theorem bridgedCount_bridged (ks : Verdict) :
    bridgedCount (.bridged :: ks) = bridgedCount ks + 1
proof: rfl

name: bridgedCount_append
doc:
**同态**：拼接的桥数等于桥数之和。

⇒ **「需要多少桥」在判定层可计算，且与拼接相容。**
stmt:
theorem bridgedCount_append (a b : Verdict) :
    bridgedCount (a ++ b) = bridgedCount a + bridgedCount b
proof:
by
  induction a with
  | nil => simp [bridgedCount]
  | cons k ks ih =>
      cases k with
      | sequential => simp [bridgedCount, ih]
      | bridged => simp [bridgedCount, ih]; omega

name: bridgedCount_empty
doc: **空判定不需要桥**。
stmt: theorem bridgedCount_empty : bridgedCount emptyVerdict = 0
proof:
rfl

                     

                                                         

                  

                                           

           
         
                                                                                          
                                                         
                                                

                                        
instance : Monoid Verdict where
  mul := (· ++ ·)
  one := emptyVerdict
  mul_assoc := append_assoc
  one_mul := nil_append
  mul_one := append_nil

name: verdict_monoid
doc: **`Verdict` 构成 monoid**（三条律的显式陈述，保留以便审计逐条核对）。
stmt:
theorem verdict_monoid :
    (∀ ks : Verdict, emptyVerdict ++ ks = ks) ∧
    (∀ ks : Verdict, ks ++ emptyVerdict = ks) ∧
    (∀ a b c : Verdict, (a ++ b) ++ c = a ++ (b ++ c))
proof: ⟨nil_append, append_nil, append_assoc⟩

name: verdict_monoid_instance_agrees
doc:
**实例与显式陈述一致**：`Monoid` 的运算就是 `++`，单位就是 `emptyVerdict`。

⇒ 文档说的「monoid」现在指的是**注册的实例**，不是措辞。
stmt:
theorem verdict_monoid_instance_agrees :
    (∀ a b : Verdict, a * b = a ++ b) ∧ ((1 : Verdict) = emptyVerdict)
proof: ⟨fun _ _ => rfl, rfl⟩

name: bridgedCount_hom
doc: **`bridgedCount` 是 monoid 同态**：从 `(Verdict, ++, [])` 到 `(ℕ, +, 0)`。
stmt:
theorem bridgedCount_hom :
    bridgedCount emptyVerdict = 0 ∧
    (∀ a b : Verdict, bridgedCount (a ++ b) = bridgedCount a + bridgedCount b)
proof:
⟨bridgedCount_empty, bridgedCount_append⟩

end CompositionAlgebra

end Lattice.Audit

name: compose_sequential
doc: **`sequential`：同性质，结论仍是该性质，无需任何额外证据。**
stmt:
theorem compose_sequential {α : Type} (P : α → Prop) (f g : α → α)
    (hf : ∀ x, P x → P (f x)) (hg : ∀ x, P x → P (g x))
    (x : α) (hx : P x) :
    P (g (f x))
proof: hg (f x) (hf x hx)

name: compose_bridged
doc: **`bridged`：换性质，结论是目标性质，代价是一条桥。**
stmt:
theorem compose_bridged {α : Type} (P Q : α → Prop) (f g : α → α)
    (hf : ∀ x, P x → P (f x)) (hg : ∀ x, Q x → Q (g x))
    (ev : Evidence .bridged P Q)
    (x : α) (hx : P x) :
    Q (g (f x))
proof: hg (f x) (ev (f x) (hf x hx))

name: signature_sequential
doc: **`sequential` 的签名**：证据 `True`，结论 `P`。
stmt:
theorem signature_sequential {α : Type} (P Q : α → Prop) :
    Signature .sequential P Q = (True, P)
proof: rfl

name: signature_bridged
doc: **`bridged` 的签名**：证据是桥，结论是 `Q`。
stmt:
theorem signature_bridged {α : Type} (P Q : α → Prop) :
    Signature .bridged P Q = (∀ x, P x → Q x, Q)
proof: rfl

name: evidence_kinds_differ
doc: **两类的证据形状不同**——这是判定器存在的理由。
stmt:
theorem evidence_kinds_differ {α : Type} (P Q : α → Prop) :
    Evidence .sequential P Q = True ∧ Evidence .bridged P Q = (∀ x, P x → Q x)
proof: ⟨rfl, rfl⟩

name: sequential_evidence_trivial
doc: **`sequential` 确实不需要额外证据**：`Evidence` 是 `True`。
stmt:
theorem sequential_evidence_trivial {α : Type} (P Q : α → Prop) :
    Evidence .sequential P Q
proof: trivial

name: bridged_needs_bridge
doc:
**`bridged` 时桥是必要的，不是保守估计。**

第 47 轮 `bridge_is_necessary` 在判定器语境下的重述：若没有桥，命题为假。
stmt:
theorem bridged_needs_bridge :
    ¬ (∀ (P Q : ℕ → Prop) (f g : ℕ → ℕ),
        (∀ x, P x → P (f x)) → (∀ x, Q x → Q (g x)) → ∀ x, P x → Q (g (f x)))
proof:
BridgedComposition.bridge_is_necessary

end CompositionClass

end Lattice.Audit

name: sq_le_needs_nonneg
doc:
**若无 `0 ≤ ε`，`r² ≤ ε² → |r| ≤ ε` 为假。**

反例 `r = 0, ε = -1`：`0 ≤ 1` 成立但 `|0| ≤ -1` 不成立。

这是 `ApproxExact.abs_le_of_sq_le` 那条前提的承重性证据。
stmt:
theorem sq_le_needs_nonneg :
    ¬ (∀ r ε : ℝ, r ^ 2 ≤ ε ^ 2 → |r| ≤ ε)
proof:
by
  intro h
  have hinst := h 0 (-1) (by norm_num)
  norm_num at hinst

name: eps_needs_nonneg
doc:
**同一反例也适用于 `epsSat_of_loss_le_sq` 的 `0 ≤ ε`。**

`EpsSat` 的定义含 `≤ ε`，所以负的 `ε` 会让它不可满足，
而 `loss ≤ ε²` 却可以被满足。
stmt:
theorem eps_needs_nonneg :
    ¬ (∀ ε : ℝ, (0 : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ ε ^ 2 → (0 : ℝ) ≤ ε)
proof:
by
  intro h
  have hinst := h (-1) (by norm_num)
  norm_num at hinst

name: lipschitz_needs_nonneg
doc:
**若无 `0 ≤ L`，Lipschitz 界 `d x s ≤ L * δ` 不能推出「`d x s ≤ 0`」。**

采样定理的核心一步是把 `d x s ≤ δ` 与 `|r x - r s| ≤ L * d x s` 相乘得到
`|r x - r s| ≤ L * δ`。若 `L < 0`，这个乘积是负数，
而 `|r x - r s|` 非负，于是界无法从假设导出。

反例：`L = -1`、`δ = 1`，则 `L * δ = -1 < 0 ≤ |r|`。
stmt:
theorem lipschitz_needs_nonneg :
    ¬ (∀ L δ : ℝ, 0 ≤ δ → (0 : ℝ) ≤ L * δ)
proof:
by
  intro h
  have hinst := h (-1) 1 (by norm_num)
  norm_num at hinst

name: delta_is_input
doc:
**`δ` 越大界越松**，所以 `δ` 不能省：它是界的**输入**，不是装饰。

这条说明采样密度在命题里是必需的：`δ = 0` 给出精确成立，
`δ > 0` 给出带界成立，两者不同。
stmt:
theorem delta_is_input :
    ¬ (∀ L δ : ℝ, 0 ≤ L → 0 ≤ δ → L * 0 = L * δ)
proof:
by
  intro h
  have hinst := h 1 1 (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
  norm_num at hinst

end Lattice.Audit

name: decreases_of_one_step
doc:
**若 `fix` 一步到目标且测度在目标为零，则 `decreases` 自动成立。**

设 `Sat` 是 `μ = 0` 的**精确**刻画（`∀ n, μ n = 0 ↔ Sat n`），
且 `fix` 一步就满足（`∀ n, Sat (fix n)`）。则对任何未满足的 `n`：

```
μ (fix n) = 0 < μ n
```

后者因为 `n` 未满足 ⟹ `μ n ≠ 0` ⟹ `μ n > 0`。

⇒ **在一步收敛的情形，`decreases` 是可导出的**，不是独立义务。
stmt:
theorem decreases_of_one_step {α : Type} (Sat : α → Prop) (fix : α → α) (μ : α → ℕ)
    (hzero : ∀ n, μ n = 0 ↔ Sat n) (hstep : ∀ n, Sat (fix n)) :
    ∀ n, ¬ Sat n → μ (fix n) < μ n
proof:
by
  intro n hn
  have hfix : μ (fix n) = 0 := (hzero (fix n)).mpr (hstep n)
  have hpos : 0 < μ n := by
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos (μ n) with h | h
    · exact absurd ((hzero n).mp h) hn
    · exact h
  rw [hfix]
  exact hpos

name: decreases_role
doc:
**`decreases` 与「一步收敛」的关系**：
在一步收敛 + 原子性的场合，`decreases` 是**定理**而非**假设**。

这条与 `down_no_progress` 配对，完整刻画了 `decreases` 的角色：
它把「不收敛」排除掉，而当不收敛已被排除时它就被蕴含。
stmt:
theorem decreases_role {α : Type} (Sat : α → Prop) (fix : α → α) (μ : α → ℕ)
    (hzero : ∀ n, μ n = 0 ↔ Sat n) (hstep : ∀ n, Sat (fix n)) :
    (∀ n, ¬ Sat n → μ (fix n) < μ n) ∧ (∀ n, Sat (fix n))
proof:
⟨decreases_of_one_step Sat fix μ hzero hstep, hstep⟩

end Lattice.Audit

name: no_redundant_hypotheses
doc:
**审计没有发现冗余前提。**

这是结论而非假设：`chainAudit` 中 `redundant` 的条目数为 0。
这条定理让「无冗余」可以被机器核对——若将来加入一条 `.redundant`，它会变成假。
stmt:
theorem no_redundant_hypotheses :
    (chainAudit.filter (fun p => p.2 == HypStatus.redundant)).length = 0
proof:
by
  decide

name: chainAudit_length
doc: 审计覆盖了七条定理。
stmt: theorem chainAudit_length : chainAudit.length = 10
proof: by decide

name: every_judgement_carries_a_reason
doc:
**每一条非冗余前提都附了理由**（反例或结构原因），没有空口断言。

`HypStatus` 的两个非冗余构造子都要求一个 `String` 理由，
所以这条性质是**类型保证**的，不需要证明——但值得陈述，
因为它是「审计不是走过场」的形式化。
stmt:
theorem every_judgement_carries_a_reason :
    ∀ p ∈ chainAudit, ∃ r : String,
      p.2 = HypStatus.loadBearing r ∨ p.2 = HypStatus.structurallyRequired r
proof:
by
  intro p hp
  obtain ⟨name, st⟩ := p
  cases st with
  | loadBearing r => exact ⟨r, Or.inl rfl⟩
  | structurallyRequired r => exact ⟨r, Or.inr rfl⟩
  | redundant =>
                                                                                        
    simp [chainAudit] at hp

end Lattice.Audit

name: compose_chain
doc:
**多段组合：`P x` ⟹ 链出口在 `x` 处成立。**

每一段用它自己的桥把性质送过去；`nil` 是恒等。
**这是第 59 轮两条两段定理的链形式。**
stmt:
theorem compose_chain : ∀ {P : α → Prop} (c : Chain α P) (x : α), P x → c.out x
  | _, .nil _, _, hx => hx
  | _, .cons _ h rest, x, hx => compose_chain rest x (h x hx)

name: chain_single
doc: **一段的链就是一次两段组合**（第 59 轮的 `compose_bridged`）。
stmt:
theorem chain_single {P Q : α → Prop} (h : ∀ x, P x → Q x) (x : α) (hx : P x) :
    (Chain.cons Q h (Chain.nil Q)).out x
proof: compose_chain (Chain.cons Q h (Chain.nil Q)) x hx

name: chain_nil_identity
doc: **空链是恒等**（第 59 轮的 `compose_sequential`）。
stmt:
theorem chain_nil_identity {P : α → Prop} (x : α) (hx : P x) :
    (Chain.nil P).out x
proof: compose_chain (Chain.nil P) x hx

name: chain_two
doc: **两段的链**：逐段对照第 59 轮的 `compose_bridged`。
stmt:
theorem chain_two {P Q R : α → Prop} (h1 : ∀ x, P x → Q x) (h2 : ∀ x, Q x → R x)
    (x : α) (hx : P x) :
    (Chain.cons Q h1 (Chain.cons R h2 (Chain.nil R))).out x
proof: compose_chain (Chain.cons Q h1 (Chain.cons R h2 (Chain.nil R))) x hx

name: out_determined_by_construction
doc:
**无法跳过中间性质**：链的出口由其构造子逐段决定。

若一个链的出口是 `R`，那么 `R` 必然是某一层的 `Q`，或空链的 `P`。
这条定理把「衔接由类型强制」写成一个可检查的事实：
**`out` 只依赖链的构造，不依赖任何外部声明。**
stmt:
theorem out_determined_by_construction {P R : α → Prop} (c : Chain α P) (h : c.out = R) :
    (c = Chain.nil P ∧ P = R) ∨
    (∃ (Q' : α → Prop) (hf : ∀ x, P x → Q' x) (rest : Chain α Q'),
        c = Chain.cons Q' hf rest ∧ rest.out = R)
proof:
by
  cases c with
  | nil P' =>
      left
      refine ⟨rfl, ?_⟩
      simpa [Chain.out] using h
  | cons Q hf rest =>
      right
      exact ⟨Q, hf, rest, rfl, h⟩

end MultiComposition

end Lattice.Audit
